what: NTRK is a group of three genes: NTRK1, NTRK2 and NTRK3.
This page is about when one of these genes joins onto another gene. This snapshot has no public gene summary for them.
intro.test_report: If a test report mentions an NTRK fusion, it is noting a finding about NTRK1, NTRK2 or NTRK3. That note is not a diagnosis, and it is not a decision about treatment.

lines.text: Entrectinib (Rozlytrek): a drug that blocks the NTRK signal. Approved for advanced lung cancer with an NTRK fusion. Authorised in Europe since 2020.
Larotrectinib (VITRAKVI): a drug named on the FDA label in this snapshot. Approved for several types of solid tumour with an NTRK fusion.
Repotrectinib (Augtyro): a drug that blocks the NTRK signal. Approved for advanced lung cancer with an NTRK fusion. Authorised in Europe since 2025.
